items.title: File Widerspruch against rejection of Erwerbsminderungsrente
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid ist innerhalb eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe der Widerspruch zulässig.
items.computation: The letter is dated 18.11.2026 (Wednesday) and contains no separate 'zur Post gegeben am' date, so the posting day is 18.11.2026. The sender is a statutory pension insurance fund (Deutsche Rentenversicherung), a social-law body under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X. For such bodies the deemed delivery day is the 4th calendar day after posting and does NOT move even if it falls on a weekend (unlike tax offices). 18.11.2026 + 4 days = 22.11.2026 (a Sunday) — this stands as the deemed delivery (Bekanntgabe) day. The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 SGG) then runs from the day after delivery (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB), i.e. starting 23.11.2026, and ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): 22.12.2026. Since 22.12.2026 is a Tuesday and not a public holiday in NRW, no further shift under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X is needed.
